title: UDP Read
text: Receive UDP packets from remote host, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Data type} sets Data type of received data; {Local port} sets the iP port number of local host, {Maximum data length (elements)} sets the maximum length of output UDP packet, {Receive buffer size (bytes)} sets the number of data bytes in received data, {Enable event-based execution} enables or disable event-based task and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: length
ports.summary: Length of received UDP packet nonnegative scalar

params.name: Local port
params.values: IP port number of local host 25000 (default) | integer from 1 to 65,535

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of received data uint8 (default) | single | double | int8 | int16 | int32 | uint16 | uint32

params.name: Maximum data length (elements)
params.values: Maximum length of output UDP packet 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Receive buffer size (bytes)
params.values: Number of data bytes in received data 65535 (default) | integer from 1 to 65,535

params.name: Enable event-based execution
params.values: Enable or disable event-based task execution off (default) | on
